response.sql: WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, c.town_city AS town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_avg AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town_avg) AS ratio_excess FROM town_avg WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town_avg)
